dialogs.text: Hey! I'm over here, you know?
Young people these days... Don't you kids have any kind of courtesy at all?
S—Sorry!
Hmph! That's more like it. As for those mushrooms, let's just call that my gift... But don't you touch the rest however you like!
Are these your mushrooms?
None of your business! Just stop picking them however you like and get out of here!

Are these your mushrooms?
None of your business! Just stop picking them however you like and get out of here!
Eek! That guy just now... Did you see that!?
Nope.
Uhh, that's just too spooky. Let's just grab a few mushrooms and get out of here, shall we?
Must've been an illusion.
Eek! That guy just now... Did you see that!?
Nope.
Uhh, that's just too spooky. Let's just grab a few mushrooms and get out of here, shall we?
Must've been an illusion.
Hey! Hey! Didn't I warn you lot before!? Are you hard of hearing, or do you just not have eyes, huh?
Oh, look, a ghost!
Eek! Ghost? Where? Where!?
Right here.
Aaaagh! Go! Shoo! Evil begone! By my clan's name, Abe, depart from this place!
...What? N—No! That can't be! I've... I've never encountered such a wicked spirit in all my years! Wh—Why aren't you leaving?
Why, I've come from beyond this island.
An evil spirit from beyond the Sea of Fog? I—I'm not afraid of you! Just you wait! Th—The Great Thunderbird will exorcise you!
Your Thunderbird is long gone.
Wh—What did you say?
Everyone's left.
What... What are you saying? D—Don't you try to scare me like that. Ohhh, I—I'm getting goosebumps already...
Still, there have been fewer and fewer people on the island lately. Kina also told me that everyone was getting onboard the boat... *sigh* Who knows where that kid's run off to now...
Wait a moment. Spirit from beyond this island... Aren't you leaving too? On the silver boat by the seashore?
I saw no boat there.
Huh... I knew it. I knew outsiders wouldn't be able to see that boat.
Still, thanks for telling me to get onboard, evil spirit. It's... It's just that I've lived here for so long, and yet there's so much I still haven't seen or done... I can't just leave this place!
What will you need?
Need? Eh? I mean, it's not as if I need anything. I'd just like to see something new, you know?
Once, when I was still very young, I made a bet with Una that there were different kinds of mushrooms outside our island, but she wouldn't believe me.
Later, her husband went out to sea, leaving for lands where the outsiders live. He never returned, and they say his spirit wanders the lands beyond... Poor guy.
Una's been living alone ever since then. Every time I think about it, I... *sigh*
Don't worry about her too much.
I even begged the priest, you know? At the very least, we had to give someone a place to stay... Ah, right, right! The mushrooms!

*cough* Well, I'll be boarding the boat soon, and I don't really have that many regrets... I just haven't seen anything that lies beyond our island. Still, that which concerns me most has to be those mushrooms I take care of every day...
Please, help me bring back some mushrooms from beyond the Sea of Fog. I'd love to see what they look like!
Please help me, evil outsider spirit!
So about the mushrooms...
That ship was not made to bear me hence.
It's time to leave.
The Sea of Fog is a thing of the past.

Will these mushrooms do for you?
Ooh! Haha... Wow, they've got such odd shapes! Do they have souls, too? Do they contain peoples' memories?
And these soft, wing-like things... Can they fly?
Ah, me and my endless curiosity! The boatman's getting annoyed now, I think. I'm sorry, but I reckon I must go. Yes, I must...
